name: PawBench
intro: PawBench 是面向 Agentic AI 的 Model × Harness 联合评测基准，强调同一个模型放入不同 Agent runtime 后表现可能显著不同。v1.0 覆盖 9 个模型、3 个 harness 和 150 个任务，提供公开 prompts、graders、任务标签、提交结果、leaderboard 切片和诊断 trace。
build_method: Reuse & Tag, 统一任务合同, Model × Harness联合运行
metric: Overall score, Slice scores, Harness gap
modality: 文本, 多模态, 工具
task_type: Agent任务, Harness评估, 工具调用
eval_feature: 6类任务来源, 5维正交标签, 3种评分模式, Model × Harness共评估, 诊断trace
scale: 150个任务, 9个模型, 3个Harness, 6类任务来源
task_type_en: Agent task, Harness evaluation, Tool use
build_method_en: Reuse and Tag, unified task contracts, Model × Harness execution
eval_feature_en: Six task sources, five orthogonal tags, three grading modes, Model × Harness co-evaluation, diagnostic traces
intro_en: PawBench is a Model × Harness co-evaluation benchmark for agentic AI, built around the observation that the same model can behave very differently inside different agent runtimes. v1.0 covers 9 models, 3 harnesses, and 150 tasks, with public prompts, graders, task labels, submissions, leaderboard slices, and diagnostic traces.
metric_en: Overall score, Slice scores, Harness gap
drawio_review_note: Aligned with the official PawBench repository and project page. PawBench v1.0 uses Reuse & Tag to combine 21 self-built tasks with 52 ClawEval, 29 QwenClawBench, 23 PinchBench, 15 SkillsBench, and 10 WildClawBench tasks, normalizes all 150 tasks to one prompt/workspace/result contract, and tags scenario, capability, complexity, modality, and environment. The same tasks are run across 9 models and QwenPaw, OpenClaw, and Hermes harnesses. Outcomes use automated, LLM-judge, or hybrid grading; the published baseline uses Claude Opus 4.6 for LLM judging. Results are sliced by task and execution attributes, while transcripts and harness gaps support diagnosis. No standalone paper is published, so the official repository is the primary methodology source.
